findings.title: Workspace overview renders activeCount cleanly once summary resolves
findings.detail: Populated state displays active campaign count with a nullish fallback to 0.
findings.recommendation: No change required on the populated overview.

findings.title: Unrouted first-run wizard asks new users for internal schema version and priority
findings.detail: Sweep 1b found a state-switched wizard (currentStep === "welcome") that prompts a first-time user for "Priority (Low / Medium / High)" and "Internal schema version" before they have seen the workspace.
findings.recommendation: In src/screens/dashboard.jsx:29-37, remove the Priority and Internal schema version <input> elements and start new workspaces directly on the overview with a single inline "Create first campaign" CTA.

history.from: Remove the Priority and Internal schema version inputs from the welcome step.
history.to: In src/screens/dashboard.jsx:29-37, remove the Priority and Internal schema version <input> elements and start new workspaces directly on the overview with a single inline "Create first campaign" CTA.

findings.title: Survey header states a clear 3-respondent privacy floor to participants
findings.detail: The survey header explicitly promises respondents that leadership only sees a combined reading once at least 3 teammates have completed the checkup.
findings.recommendation: Enforce this 3-respondent privacy floor on every admin read surface.

findings.title: Invitations table leaks individual respondent scores and raw surveyHash bearer links
findings.detail: Every row in InvitationsScreen prints p.individualScore% by name and renders /survey/{p.surveyHash} in the DOM, breaking the privacy promise in survey.jsx:9-13 and exposing each participant bearer token.
findings.recommendation: Remove the Individual Score and Magic Link columns from InvitationsScreen; show only Name and Completed/Pending status.

findings.title: Completed vs Pending status column gives clear per-participant progress feedback
findings.detail: The Status column cleanly distinguishes Completed from Pending respondents without exposing answers.
findings.recommendation: Keep the Name and Status columns as the sole columns in InvitationsScreen.

findings.title: Upgrade to Pro button hardcodes plan: "business" in checkout payload
findings.detail: startUpgrade(selectedTier) ignores selectedTier for the plan key and sends { plan: "business", sourceTier: selectedTier }, making the highlighted Pro plan impossible to buy.
findings.recommendation: Pass plan: selectedTier in startUpgrade at src/screens/billing.jsx:8.

findings.title: Invoices empty state is a bare "No invoices" string
findings.detail:
When invoices.length === 0, BillingScreen renders a bare
No invoices
with no explanation of when invoices appear.
findings.recommendation: Replace the bare string at src/screens/billing.jsx:31 with an empty state explaining that invoices appear after the first billing cycle.

findings.title: LegacyV1Modal uses low-contrast #ccc text on #fff background
findings.detail: Inline style sets color: #ccc on background: #fff.

findings.title: SQL injection in attachMembersToCampaign via sql template literal
findings.detail: attachMembersToCampaign interpolates campaignId and memberId into sql`...` template strings.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries instead of template strings.

findings.title: attachMembersToCampaign does not scope memberIds to currentUser.tenantId (cross-tenant IDOR)
findings.detail: attachMembersToCampaign verifies campaign ownership at line 5, but loads each memberId with WHERE id = ${memberId} only (line 15), allowing any tenant to attach another tenant's members to their campaign.
findings.recommendation: Add AND tenant_id = ${currentUser.tenantId} to the members lookup in src/actions/team-actions.js:15.

findings.title: attachMembersToCampaign executes an unbounded 2N sequential query loop per memberId
findings.detail: Lines 14-21 run a sequential SELECT and INSERT inside for (const memberId of memberIds) with no batching or length cap, causing 2N DB round-trips.
findings.recommendation: In src/actions/team-actions.js:14-21, deduplicate and cap `const ids = [...new Set(memberIds)].slice(0, 200)`, query `WHERE id = ANY(${ids}) AND tenant_id = ${currentUser.tenantId}` in one round-trip, and insert all matched rows in one multi-row INSERT.

history.from: Replace the per-member SELECT/INSERT loop with a single batched WHERE id = ANY($1) query and multi-row INSERT.
history.to: In src/actions/team-actions.js:14-21, deduplicate and cap `const ids = [...new Set(memberIds)].slice(0, 200)`, query `WHERE id = ANY(${ids}) AND tenant_id = ${currentUser.tenantId}` in one round-trip, and insert all matched rows in one multi-row INSERT.

findings.title: Dashboard catch handler never clears isLoading, pinning the screen in a permanent skeleton on error
findings.detail: In src/screens/dashboard.jsx:15-20, .catch() calls setError(...) without calling setIsLoading(false). Because if (isLoading) at line 23 precedes if (error) at line 27, a failed fetchSummary() leaves the skeleton mounted forever and the error banner is unreachable.
findings.recommendation: Call setIsLoading(false) inside the .catch() block at src/screens/dashboard.jsx:18 (or in a .finally() handler) and add a Retry button to the error-banner at line 27.

findings.title: Results unlock at completedCount >= 1, exposing the first respondent's private answers as the company average
findings.detail: SurveyScreen (src/screens/survey.jsx:9-13) promises participants that leadership only sees a combined reading once at least 3 teammates respond. ResultsScreen (src/screens/results.jsx:8-14) gates on campaign.completedCount < 1 and says "Results unlock as soon as one person completes a checkup", so at N=1 the aggregate score is the first respondent's exact answers.
findings.recommendation: Export MIN_RESPONDENTS = 3 and gate ResultsScreen at src/screens/results.jsx:8 on campaign.completedCount < MIN_RESPONDENTS, updating the empty-state copy at line 11 to match survey.jsx.
